purpose: Runtime data manifest. Canonical model count must be derived from boatmodels.json rather than maintained as a stale constant.
principles: Each model field has exactly one owner declared in data/canonical/ownership.json.
boatmodels.json is a validated generated public view, never an editable source.
Secondary data may contain identities, taxonomies, production-phase overrides, evidence, provenance, resources, or community proposals, but not a competing current model specification database.
Production-phase values are scoped overrides, not duplicate model-wide values.
Evidence assertions document provenance and may quote sourced facts without becoming authoritative current specifications.
Fields at or above 95% operational coverage do not require active cleanup; remaining blanks are community contribution opportunities.
Low-confidence estimates are visibly marked and do not hard-eliminate a candidate.

operationalCompletenessPolicy.rule: A field at or above 95% resolved/usable coverage leaves active cleanup priority.
operationalCompletenessPolicy.communityRole: Remaining blanks stay visible as contribution opportunities.

notes: Public views are generated from source-only canonical datasets. Historical research is excluded from the public build.
Identity registry records are historical identity decisions; PendingReview is preserved without promoting verification.
Phase 2: public model files and SEO are generated during the build; boatmodels.json is an output-only compatibility endpoint until client migration.
